Algorithmic Trader.description: Writes the code that actually executes trades. Needs to understand how markets move on a second-by-second basis.

Credit Risk Quant.description: Focuses on the risk of people or companies defaulting on their debts. Heavy on probability and statistical modeling.

Front Office Quant.description: Develops and applies quantitative models for pricing, risk management, and trading strategies directly on the trading desk.

Market Risk Quant.description: Develops and validates models to measure and manage market risk, ensuring the bank stays within its limits and regulatory requirements.

Quant Developer.description: The backbone of the operation. They build the high-performance systems that the math runs on.

Quant Researcher.description: The 'think tank' role. Conducts cutting-edge research to find new trading signals or better ways to price assets.

Validation Quant.description: The 'internal police.' They independently check models built by other quants to make sure they aren't broken or dangerous.
